_comment: Manual overrides applied by scripts/build_draft.py on top of ESPN's projections, for news newer than ESPN's numbers. Keyed by full name. projGp replaces ESPN's projected games; minScale multiplies every counting stat (role change); recent ('last15' or 'last30') + recentWeight blends the projection toward that late-season per-game line; status overrides ESPN's injury status when it lags the news; note is shown on the player's card. Re-run the export after editing.

Paul George.note: Age 36, 37 games last season, traded PHI to BOS. ESPN's 55 games and 33.2 minutes (up from 30.6) read optimistic: cut to 44 games and production scaled 0.82 for age decline, a smaller role on a new team, and load management.

Kyrie Irving.note: Torn left ACL March 2025; hasn't played in 19 months, age 34. Says he has no restrictions, but cut ESPN's 59 games to 46 and production scaled 0.86 for ramp-up, minutes management and re-injury risk.

Derik Queen.note: Ended 2025-26 in a bigger role: last 15 days 15.3 pts / 9.1 reb / 1.9 stl / 1.3 blk on 12.4 FGA (7 games), vs 11.7 / 7.1 / 1.0 / 0.9 for the season. ESPN's projection follows the full season, so it is blended 50% toward the late-season line (half-credit for a 7-game sample).

Caleb Wilson.note: Rookie (CHI). ESPN's line (17.9 pts / 8.1 reb / 1.4 blk) reads conservative next to the outside ranks (ESPN 57, FantasyPros 73, ADP 72) that put him well above this board's #95. Production scaled x1.12 for a bigger role than ESPN assumes.
